points.title: The BCI app store
points.signal: A regulator clears a standardized software / API layer for a commercial BCI (with medical guardrails), and the first third-party app launches and is adopted.
points.cascade: BCI value compounds after surgery; a developer ecosystem forms; demand shifts toward elective use.

points.title: Neural distillation
points.signal: A major lab matches frontier reasoning by training on human neural data at a fraction of the parameters / energy, or venture funding surges into consumer EEG to harvest cognitive data for AI.
points.cascade: High-fidelity neural data becomes as valuable to AI as text; comp-neuro talent flow reverses.

points.title: The neuromorphic energy pivot
points.signal: A brain-inspired model matches state-of-the-art performance at 3+ orders of magnitude better energy efficiency, and frontier labs begin acquiring neuromorphic startups.
points.cascade: Neurally derived design becomes foundational to commercial AI; AI is tethered to neuroscience.

points.title: Memory retrieval in simulation
points.signal: A reconstructed mouse connectome simulated in silico reproduces a specific behavior the biological mouse learned before its connectome was harvested.
points.cascade: WBE turns from speculation into a benchmarked engineering discipline; serious policy engagement begins.
